agent_answer: Raj’s request for a gift record reveals that his relationship with collecting has changed from a data-driven, strictly curated approach to one that is now open to records he has no prior information about. Specifically, he asks for a record he "wouldn't have put on his want-list six months ago." This marks a clear shift: his want-list looks different than it did in January — influenced by the Antwerp trip with Priya (which led to the Soft Machine record) and Nadia’s listening session (which led to Polish records). The change is underscored by the fact that, after hearing Nadia’s Polish record, he wanted to know more about its maker — something he "has never said about a record he didn't already have data on." So his gift request signals that his collecting is no longer limited to items backed by data; it now embraces discovery and personal/emotional connection, a shift in his approach.
